verses.en: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hephzi-bah.
verses.pt: De doze anos era Manassés quando começou a reinar, e reinou em Jerusalém cinquenta e cinco anos: o nome de sua mãe foi Hefzibá.
verses.en_web: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hephzibah.
verses.en_bbe: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king; for fifty-five years he was ruling in Jerusalem; and his mother's name was Hephzi-bah.

verses.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, after the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
verses.pt: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR, segundo as abominações das nações que o SENHOR havia lançado diante dos filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, after the abominations of the nations whom Yahweh cast out before the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, copying the disgusting ways of those nations whom the Lord had sent out before the children of Israel.

verses.en: For he built up again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he reared up altars for Baal, and made a grove, as did Ahab king of Israel; and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.
verses.pt: Porque ele voltou a edificar os altos que Ezequias seu pai havia derrubado, e levantou altares a Baal, e fez bosque, como havia feito Acabe rei de Israel: e adorou a todo o exército do céu, e serviu àquelas coisas.
verses.en_web: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he raised up altars for Baal, and made an Asherah, as Ahab king of Israel did, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served them.
verses.en_bbe: He put up again the high places which had been pulled down by Hezekiah his father; he made altars for Baal, and an Asherah, as Ahab, king of Israel, had done; he was a worshipper and servant of all the stars of heaven.

verses.en: And he built altars in the house of the LORD, of which the LORD said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.
verses.pt: Também edificou altares na casa do SENHOR, da qual o SENHOR havia dito: Eu porei meu nome em Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: He built altars in Yahweh’s house, of which Yahweh said, “I will put my name in Jerusalem.”
verses.en_bbe: And he put up altars in the house of the Lord, of which the Lord had said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.

verses.en: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD.
verses.pt: E edificou altares para todo o exército do céu nos dois átrios da casa do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: He built altars for all the army of the sky in the two courts of Yahweh’s house.
verses.en_bbe: And he put up altars for all the stars of heaven in the two outer squares of the house of the Lord.

verses.en: And he made his son pass through the fire, and observed times, and used enchantments, and dealt with familiar spirits and wizards: he wrought much wickedness in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.
verses.pt: E passou a seu filho por fogo, e olhou em tempos, e foi agoureiro, e instituiu necromantes e adivinhos, multiplicando assim o fazer o mal aos olhos do SENHOR, para provocá-lo à ira.
verses.en_web: He made his son to pass through the fire, practiced sorcery, used enchantments, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits, and with wizards. He did much evil in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger.
verses.en_bbe: And he made his son go through the fire, and made use of secret arts and signs for reading the future; he gave positions to those who had control of spirits and to wonder-workers; he did much evil in the eyes of the Lord, moving him to wrath.

verses.en: And he set a graven image of the grove that he had made in the house, of which the LORD said to David, and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:
verses.pt: E pôs uma imagem entalhada do bosque que ele havia feito, na casa da qual havia o SENHOR dito a Davi e a Salomão seu filho: Eu porei meu nome para sempre nesta casa, e em Jerusalém, à qual escolhi de todas as tribos de Israel:
verses.en_web: He set the engraved image of Asherah that he had made in the house of which Yahweh said to David and to Solomon his son, “In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, will I put my name forever;
verses.en_bbe: He put the image of Asherah which he had made in the house of which the Lord had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, the town which I have made mine out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name for ever.

verses.en: Neither will I make the feet of Israel move any more out of the land which I gave their fathers; only if they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.
verses.pt: E não voltarei a fazer que o pé de Israel seja movido da terra que dei a seus pais, contanto que guardem e façam conforme a todas as coisas que eu lhes mandei, e conforme a toda a lei que meu servo Moisés lhes mandou.
verses.en_web: I will not cause the feet of Israel to wander any more out of the land which I gave their fathers, if only they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.”
verses.en_bbe: And never again will I send the feet of Israel wandering from the land which I gave to their fathers; if only they will take care to do all my orders, and keep all the law which my servant Moses gave them.

verses.en: But they hearkened not: and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than did the nations whom the LORD destroyed before the children of Israel.
verses.pt: Mas eles não escutaram; e Manassés os induziu a que fizessem mais mal que as nações que o SENHOR destruiu diante dos filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: But they didn’t listen, and Manasseh seduced them to do that which is evil more than the nations did whom Yahweh destroyed before the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: But they did not give ear; and Manasseh made them do more evil than those nations did, whom the Lord gave up to destruction before the children of Israel.

verses.en: And the LORD spake by his servants the prophets, saying,
verses.pt: E falou o SENHOR por meio de seus servos os profetas, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke by his servants the prophets, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said, by his servants the prophets,

verses.en: Because Manasseh king of Judah hath done these abominations, and hath done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, which were before him, and hath made Judah also to sin with his idols:
verses.pt: Porquanto Manassés rei de Judá fez estas abominações, e fez mais mal que tudo o que fizeram os amorreus que foram antes dele, e também fez pecar a Judá em seus ídolos;
verses.en_web: “Because Manasseh king of Judah has done these abominations, and has done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, who were before him, and has also made Judah to sin with his idols;
verses.en_bbe: Because Manasseh, king of Judah, has done these disgusting things, doing more evil than all the Amorites before him, and making Judah do evil with his false gods,

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Behold, I am bringing such evil upon Jerusalem and Judah, that whosoever heareth of it, both his ears shall tingle.
verses.pt: Portanto, assim disse o SENHOR o Deus de Israel: Eis que eu trago tal mal sobre Jerusalém e sobre Judá, que o que o ouvir, lhe retinirão ambos ouvidos.
verses.en_web: therefore Yahweh the God of Israel says, ‘Behold, I bring such evil on Jerusalem and Judah that whoever hears of it, both his ears will tingle.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause, says the Lord, the God of Israel, I will send such evil on Jerusalem and Judah that the ears of all to whom the news comes will be burning.

verses.en: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish, wiping it, and turning it upside down.
verses.pt: E estenderei sobre Jerusalém o cordel de Samaria, e o prumo da casa de Acabe: e eu limparei a Jerusalém como se limpa um prato, que depois que o limpam, viram-no sobre sua face.
verses.en_web: I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of Ahab’s house; and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down.
verses.en_bbe: And over Jerusalem will be stretched the line of Samaria and the weight of Ahab; Jerusalem will be washed clean as a plate is washed, and turned over on its face.

verses.en: And I will forsake the remnant of mine inheritance, and deliver them into the hand of their enemies; and they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies;
verses.pt: E desampararei os restantes de minha propriedade, e os entregarei em mãos de seus inimigos; e serão para saque e para roubo a todos seus adversários;
verses.en_web: I will cast off the remnant of my inheritance, and deliver them into the hands of their enemies. They will become a prey and a plunder to all their enemies,
verses.en_bbe: And I will put away from me the rest of my heritage, and give them up into the hands of their haters, who will take their property and their goods for themselves;

verses.en: Because they have done that which was evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came forth out of Egypt, even unto this day.
verses.pt: Porquanto fizeram o mal aos meus olhos, e me provocaram à ira, desde o dia que seus pais saíram do Egito até hoje.
verses.en_web: because they have done that which is evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came out of Egypt, even to this day.’”
verses.en_bbe: Because they have done evil in my eyes, moving me to wrath, from the day when their fathers came out of Egypt till this day.

verses.en: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; beside his sin wherewith he made Judah to sin, in doing that which was evil in the sight of the LORD.
verses.pt: Além disso, derramou Manassés muito sangue inocente em grande maneira, até encher a Jerusalém de extremidade a extremidade; além de seu pecado com que fez pecar a Judá, para que fizesse o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, until he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; besides his sin with which he made Judah to sin, in doing that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight.
verses.en_bbe: More than this, Manasseh took the lives of upright men, till Jerusalem from one end to the other was full of blood; in addition to his sin in making Judah do evil in the eyes of the Lord.

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.pt: Os demais dos feitos de Manassés, e todas as coisas que fez, e seu pecado que cometeu, não está tudo escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Judá?
verses.en_web: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.en_bbe: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all he did, and his sins, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah?

verses.en: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.pt: E descansou Manassés com seus pais, e foi sepultado no jardim de sua casa, no jardim de Uzá; e reinou em seu lugar Amom seu filho.
verses.en_web: Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza; and Amon his son reigned in his place.
verses.en_bbe: So Manasseh went to rest with his fathers, and was put into the earth in the garden of his house, in the garden of Uzza; and Amon his son became king in his place.

verses.en: Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
verses.pt: De vinte e dois anos era Amom quando começou a reinar, e reinou dois anos em Jerusalém. O nome de sua mãe foi Mesulemete filha de Haruz de Jotbá.
verses.en_web: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Meshullemeth the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
verses.en_bbe: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, ruling in Jerusalem for two years; his mother's name was Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.

verses.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as his father Manasseh did.
verses.pt: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR, como havia feito Manassés seu pai.
verses.en_web: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as Manasseh his father did.
verses.en_bbe: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, as Manasseh his father had done.

verses.en: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshipped them:
verses.pt: E andou em todos os caminhos em que seu pai andou, e serviu às imundícias às quais havia servido seu pai, e a elas adorou;
verses.en_web: He walked in all the ways that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshiped them;
verses.en_bbe: He went in all the ways of his father, being a servant and worshipper of the false gods to which his father had been a servant;

verses.en: And he forsook the LORD God of his fathers, and walked not in the way of the LORD.
verses.pt: E deixou ao SENHOR o Deus de seus pais, e não andou no caminho do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: and he abandoned Yahweh, the God of his fathers, and didn’t walk in the way of Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Turning away from the Lord, the God of his fathers, and not walking in his ways.

verses.en: And the servants of Amon conspired against him, and slew the king in his own house.
verses.pt: E os servos de Amom conspiraram contra ele, e mataram ao rei em sua casa.
verses.en_web: The servants of Amon conspired against him, and put the king to death in his own house.
verses.en_bbe: And the servants of Amon made a secret design against him, and put the king to death in his house.

verses.en: And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.
verses.pt: Então o povo da terra feriu a todos os que haviam conspirado contra o rei Amom; e pôs o povo da terra por rei em seu lugar a Josias seu filho.
verses.en_web: But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place.
verses.en_bbe: But the people of the land put to death all those who had taken part in the design against the king, and made Josiah his son king in his place.

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.pt: Os demais dos feitos de Amom, que efetuara, não está tudo escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Judá?
verses.en_web: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.en_bbe: Now the rest of the acts which Amon did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah?

verses.en: And he was buried in his sepulchre in the garden of Uzza: and Josiah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.pt: E foi sepultado em seu sepulcro no jardim de Uzá, e reinou em seu lugar Josias seu filho.
verses.en_web: He was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza, and Josiah his son reigned in his place.
verses.en_bbe: He was put in his last resting-place in the garden of Uzza, and Josiah his son became king in his place.
